feeds.title: Look! We're Learning Blog
feeds.description: We're committed to making learning fun for kids! Follow us to get kid-approved teaching ideas and activities that are hands-on, cool, and just plain fun!

feeds.title: Tina's Dynamic Homeschool Plus Blog
feeds.description: I blog about my experience learned through many years of homeschooling. Along the way I have created and sell a program, New Bee Homeschooler that has helped hundreds and hundreds of new and struggling homeschoolers, and a unit study planner and so I offer practical advice on a wide variety of homeschooling topics from homeschooling toddlers to high schoolers.

feeds.title: Teach Beside Me Blog
feeds.description: On a mission to inspire all kids to love learning with hands-on creative teaching ideas for all!

feeds.title: Secular Homeschooler Blog
feeds.description: We are a secular homeschooling community of inspired and motivated families educating our freethinking spitfires. We are here because secular homeschoolers need a stronger voice and presence. Secular homeschooling is a fast-growing movement in the home education community.

feeds.title: My Little Poppies Blog
feeds.description: Hi, all! I'm Cait. I'm a school psychologist. I truly believe homeschooling can be almost all fun and games! You want a more connected, joy-filled homeschool Welcome to our homepage! We have lots of resources. We believe homeschool can be all fun and games.

feeds.title: Home School Science Geek
feeds.description: I'm a stay at home physicist and homeschooling parent. I went to a rural school from K-12 and was bored to tears. I have a Ph.D. in Physics and was a physics professor when my first kid was born. For the last 9 years or so I have been teaching science classes in my home for small groups of homeschoolers and I plan on sharing what we do in these classes on this website.

feeds.title: Education Possible Blog
feeds.description: Education Possible Blog is written by Megan. She advocates for a transformative middle school homeschooling experience through the integration of creative activities and unique tools. Contrary to the common perception of overwhelming challenges, she believes that these years can be the best for homeschooling. She is dedicated to helping parents and teens discover joy in learning through innovative approaches, ensuring a fulfilling middle school journey.

feeds.title: The Secular Homeschool Community Blog
feeds.description: This is the premier online destination for secular, eclectic, non-religious, inclusive, free-thinking homeschoolers.

feeds.title: Blossom & Root Blog
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to Blossom & Root! Here you will find secular homeschool curriculum and resources focusing on nature study, literature, S.T.E.A.M. and the arts, as well as stories of our homeschool adventures together!
